source_fidelity_challenges.observation: Executable public update_item publishes a description-only mutation at command end. _update_item_description says no inline reconciliation, which does not mean waiting for a later content command. This resolves the earlier delayed-sync uncertainty using new pinned implementation source, while provider queued/noissue/unsupported outcomes remain conditional.
source_fidelity_challenges.effect: Finalizer ordering can remain prescribed, but its assertion that description-alone does not sync is not supported by current public command flow.
source_fidelity_challenges.falsifier: A caller bypasses public update_item or provider result explicitly queues/unavailable; neither establishes unconditional delayed-sync until later batch.

source_fidelity_challenges.observation: Finalizer claims allcontent+status atomic batch. Executable groom_item invokes update_item→contentput/publish, then a distinct metadataintent→put/publish for mark_groomed. Batch content put alone is grouped; wholecall content/status is not shown as a single transaction.
source_fidelity_challenges.effect: Cannot convert a normative atomicity assertion into verified implementation effect; a partial publication boundary exists in the source sequence.
source_fidelity_challenges.falsifier: A governing provider transaction wraps both puts and reconciliation calls atomically, with source evidence showing rollback/commit scope; not assumed from oneMCP invocation.
